bias.en: Pullback · under the 5, 10 and 30-day, SAR at $512
bias.zh: 回调 · 位于 5、10 和 30 日均线下方，抛物线 SAR 在 $512

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.2% on Nov 13 to $523.88, trading $513.82–526.42. It is below the 5-day ($529.3) and 10-day ($529.7), both falling, and the rising 30-day ($530.6), and above the 100-day ($480.1) and 200-day ($441.4), both rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10, above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($512.11), and RSI is 48.8.
read.zh: 微软 11月13日上涨 0.2%，收于 $523.88，盘中区间 $513.82–526.42。股价位于 5 日（$529.3）和 10 日均线（$529.7）下方，二者均在下行，也位于上行的 30 日均线（$530.6）下方；位于 100 日（$480.1）和 200 日均线（$441.4）上方，二者均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$512.11），RSI 为 48.8。

read.en: No level broke on a close: the dip to $513.82 undercut the Nov 11 low, then recovered. Resistance is $524.5–530.6 (Nov 6 and 10 lows, Nov 13 high, three averages), then $533.2–534.8 and $541.3–544.2. Support is $518.5–521, then $505–512 (Nov 2 and 3 lows, SAR) and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $530.6 would target $534–544; below $512, the SAR flips and $486 opens.
read.zh: 收盘未跌破任何关键位：盘中下探 $513.82，跌破 11月11日低点，随后回升。阻力为 $524.5–530.6（11月6日和10日低点、11月13日高点、三条均线），其次 $533.2–534.8 和 $541.3–544.2。支撑为 $518.5–521，其次 $505–512（11月2日和3日低点、抛物线 SAR）和 $486（9月10日低点）。若收盘站上 $530.6，下一目标看 $534–544；若跌破 $512，抛物线 SAR 将翻空，并打开至 $486 的空间。

r.en: Oct 29 high $541.29; Nov 4 low $542.30; Nov 10 high $544.19
